verified_facts.text: The hotel occupies an 18th-century noble residence in Florence's Santa Croce neighborhood.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stay in an 18th-century noble residence in one of Florence’s most evocative neighborhoods

verified_facts.text: Inside, precious stuccoes, frescoes and original features meet high-end contemporary design.
verified_facts.excerpt: precious stuccoes, frescoes and original features meet high-end design, contemporary lines and refined comfort

verified_facts.text: Some suites have original frescoed or coffered ceilings and views over the Basilica of Santa Croce or the streets of Santa Croce.
verified_facts.excerpt: with enchanting views over the Basilica or the winding streets of Santa Croce, in suites featuring original frescoed or coffered ceilings

verified_facts.text: Studio Marco Piva transformed the hotel's signature suites, pairing historic frescoes and decorated ceilings with custom-designed furnishings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Studio Marco Piva has transformed Palazzo Firenze's signature suites into incomparable spaces. Historic frescoes and decorated ceilings dialogue with custom-designed furnishings

verified_facts.text: Room bathrooms are finished in Tuscan Breccia Capraia marble.
verified_facts.excerpt: Elegant bathroom in prestigious Tuscan marble Breccia Capraia

verified_facts.text: The Junior Suite Terrace has a balcony overlooking the rooftops and the Basilica of Santa Croce.
verified_facts.excerpt: with the exclusive privilege of a balcony overlooking the rooftops and the Basilica of Santa Croce

verified_facts.text: The Two-Bedroom Family Junior Suite has two bedrooms with views of the Basilica of Santa Croce and two marble bathrooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Two spacious, luminous bedrooms with views of the Basilica of Santa Croce

verified_facts.text: Deluxe rooms have Rubelli upholstery, dark parquet and custom-designed furniture.
verified_facts.excerpt: soft tones dialogue with refined dark parquet. Custom-designed furniture, Rubelli upholstery and natural light

verified_facts.text: Deluxe room amenities include Acqua di Parma bath amenities, an Illy coffee machine, a welcome bottle of wine and evening turn-down service.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Spacious bathroom in prestigious Tuscan marble with Acqua di Parma amenities
- Shower
- Illy coffee machine
- Daily breakfast included at the restaurant
- Welcome bottle of wine
- Evening turn-down service

verified_facts.text: Grand Deluxe Rooms have a shower with a Turkish bath.
verified_facts.excerpt: They feature a shower with a Turkish bath and overlook charming Florentine streets.

verified_facts.text: The hotel hosts live music events and aperitivo concerts in its Music Room, decorated with stuccoes.
verified_facts.excerpt: From intimate aperitivo concerts amid the precious stuccoes of the Music Room

verified_facts.text: A tour of the hotel reveals the Trestle of Santa Croce, an architectural feature once studied by Leonardo da Vinci.
verified_facts.excerpt: The “Trestle of Santa Croce” is an architectural marvel that was once studied by Leonardo DaVinci.

verified_facts.text: Attractions within walking distance include the Accademia Gallery, the Cathedral, Palazzo Vecchio, Ponte Vecchio and the Uffizi Gallery.
verified_facts.excerpt: You’ll find many historic attractions within walking distance

verified_facts.text: Guelfi and Ghibellini Restaurant serves Tuscan and Mediterranean cuisine by Chef Antonino Pepe, combining ancient recipes with modern techniques.
verified_facts.excerpt: Savor innovative Tuscan & Mediterranean cuisine that combines ancient recipes with modern and innovative cooking techniques. Marvel at Chef Antonino Pepe’s creative sense

verified_facts.text: Small and medium-sized pets are welcome, for a supplement.
verified_facts.excerpt: We welcome small/medium-sized pets (max of 15 kilos/33 lbs.)

verified_facts.text: The whole palace can be reserved for weddings and private events.
verified_facts.excerpt: Celebrate your wedding, host private events or mark special occasions in a historic palace reserved entirely for you.

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites have been redesigned, each unique in character, proportion and detail.
verified_facts.excerpt: Palazzo Firenze's rooms and suites welcome you to beautifully redesigned spaces, each unique in character, proportion and detail.

verified_facts.text: The Two-Bedroom Santa Croce Royal Suite has coffered ceilings, original decorations and three marble bathrooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Incomparable magnificence where original decorations and coffered ceilings meet thoughtfully curated contemporary furnishings. Three luxurious bathrooms in prestigious marble

verified_facts.text: Deluxe and Grand Deluxe rooms look over the streets of Santa Croce or the internal courtyard.
verified_facts.excerpt: Charming views over the streets of Santa Croce or internal courtyard
